headline: Côte d'Ivoire: SIREXE closes with 4,913 billion FCFA in investment prospects
summary: The SIREXE 2026 extractives and energy fair in Abidjan closed on November 22 with 4,913 billion CFA francs of investment intentions and 27 agreements signed. The fair was held under the presidency of the Ivorian government.
why: Investment pledges in extractives and energy signal future capital flows into West Africa's mining and energy projects.
original_headline: Côte d’Ivoire : Le SIREXE referme ses portes avec 4 913 milliards FCFA de perspectives d’investissement
